opencode._convention: User-scope skills at ~/.config/opencode/skills (dir-per-skill) per teamai-cli toolPaths userScope AND opencode v1.18 docs — NOT flat <name>.md as once assumed. `opencode mcp add` requires `--` before the command; CLI has no mcp remove, so uninstall edits opencode.jsonc directly. confidence: teamai + verified-live

antigravity._convention: MCP skipped — Antigravity IDE configures MCP in the IDE UI, not a stable file. Skills dir per platform crate convention; created on sync. Not in teamai matrix. confidence: inferred (platform crate)

codebuddy._convention: skills ~/.codebuddy/skills, rules ~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md, MCP ~/.codebuddy/mcp.json per teamai-cli toolPaths (claudemd = where teamai writes rules content). MCP stdio shape {command, args} under mcpServers per teamai-cli mcp-format renderBuddy — schema verified from teamai source, NOT live-tested (tool not installed here). confidence: teamai

MCP schema from teamai source, not live-tested. confidence: teamai

openclaw._convention: skills ~/.openclaw/skills + rules ~/.openclaw/workspace/AGENTS.md per teamai-cli toolPaths (claudemd). No MCP path in teamai source (OpenClaw MCP is not a stable file) — mcp null. confidence: teamai

hermes._convention: skills ~/.hermes/skills per teamai-cli toolPaths. teamai lists claudemd 'AGENTS.md' (workspace-relative) — no user-scope rules file. No MCP path in teamai source — mcp null. confidence: teamai

dsh._convention: DeepSeek Harness: skills ~/.dsh/skills per teamai-cli toolPaths — dsh's skill-filesystem provider scans it as user root (rank 400) and discovers both dir bundles (<name>/SKILL.md) and flat .md. No MCP or rules path in teamai source — both null. confidence: teamai

qoder._convention: skills ~/.qoder/skills per teamai-cli toolPaths. MCP ~/.qoder/settings.json mcpServers per teamai toolPaths; qoder renders with the claude-family shape, so the entry carries "type": "stdio" (engine entryType option). teamai's rules path .qoder/rules is a rules DIRECTORY (not a single instruction file) — our marker-block rulesFile doesn't apply, rulesFile null. MCP schema from teamai source, not live-tested. confidence: teamai

_notes.registry: Registry covers the full teamai-class agent universe (Tencent/teamai-cli supported matrix + this machine's own agents), not just installed CLIs. Agents absent from the machine show installed=no in status and are skipped by sync unless syncWhenAbsent is set (only cursor, config-only install). Installing one of them later is picked up automatically on the next sync.
_notes.skillsFormat: Engine supports skillsFormat 'flat' (one <name>.md per skill) in addition to default 'dir'; no current tool needs flat.

_skipped.aider: aider appears in teamai-cli's KNOWN_AGENTS (~/.aider/skills heuristic) but aider has no real skills or file-based MCP concept (config is .aider.conf.yml flags) — nothing meaningful for harness-sync to fan out.
